location.basis: Coordinates published for the site (23 deg 14 min 15 s N, 70 deg 40 min 39 s E, given by Wikipedia and a lithics study of the site) fall on an oval, densely wooded mound of about 4 ha south of the Kandla-Bhachau highway; the coordinates are those of its centre in Esri World Imagery.

main_system_reason: No Harappan line could be identified in the imagery.
notes: The mound is covered by a dense stand of trees and shrubs; no part of the excavated fortification or houses is visible. The straight features nearby are the highway, tracks and wind-turbine pads, all excluded.
